question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One’s relatives or family, related
solution: The correct answer is **"Kin."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Kin"** is a one-word substitute for the group of words **'One's relatives or family, related'.** • It is a noun and can be used to refer to one's family or relatives. (किसी का परिवार या रिश्तेदार) • **Example**: *He invited all his **kin**__ to the wedding.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - Kilt**: A traditional Scottish garment worn by men. (पुरुषों द्वारा पहना जाने वाला एक पारंपरिक स्कॉटिश परिधान) • **Option 2 - Kindle**: To start a fire or ignite something; also a brand of e-readers. (आग लगाना या कुछ जलाना; ई-रीडर्स का एक ब्रांड भी) • **Option 4 - Kine**: An archaic term for cows or cattle. (गायों या मवेशियों के लिए एक पुरातन शब्द) 38:Ta4b, The correct answer is **"as clever as."**
